user.title: SB Watch rule — what to watch
user.description: A rule watches what an SB filter matches. Across fields: AND. Within a field: OR. Nothing configured matches nothing.

data.name: Rule name
data.problem: Report as a problem (binary sensor device class)
data.filter_yaml: Advanced: filter as YAML (overrides the fields above)

data_description.patterns: Words in one pattern AND; patterns OR. * and ? wildcards.
data_description.state_for: Time in the current state, from last_changed; bare number = minutes.
data_description.for: An entity counts only after matching this long — hysteresis for flapping values.
data_description.filter_yaml: Paste an SB Entity Browser card's filter keys: patterns, labels, areas, device_classes, units, states, state_min, state_max, state_for.
data_description.rate: Change per minute/hour/day of a numeric state; comparator required; entries ORed. A sensor needs history at least as old as the window.

values.title: States and actions
values.description:
Tick the states to match — the number is how many selected entities are in each now. Type a range or number (<20, >=80, 40-60, 100) as a custom entry.

{unmatched}

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Optional: what the rule does when something becomes active.

data.act: What to do at the timeout
data.warn_ahead: Warn-ahead — act this long after notifying (notify-then-act only)
data.act_script: Script to run (when “Run a script”) — gets entity_id, entity_ids and rule as variables
data.act_actions: Actions to run (when “Run these actions”) — entity_id, entity_ids and rule are available as variables
data.notify_url: Where a tap on the notification goes (a dashboard path like /dashboard-monitor/0, or entityId:light.x; empty = the first active entity)

data_description.action: Notify replaces one notification per rule in place and clears it when nothing is active. Act calls homeassistant.<act> on the entities that just entered. The rule's Paused switch stops both.
data_description.warn_ahead: e.g. 10m. 0 = act at once after notifying.

error.empty_filter: The filter matches nothing — configure at least one field.
error.bad_yaml: The YAML is not a mapping (or does not parse).
error.bad_duration: Unreadable duration — use 2h, 1h30m, 90s, <5m or a number of minutes.
error.bad_notify: A notify service looks like notify.mobile_app_phone.
error.bad_act: Choose what to do: turn off, turn on or toggle.
error.unknown_value: A state no selected entity can be in: {unmatched}
error.bad_script: Pick a script (script.…) for “Run a script”.
error.bad_actions: Add at least one action for “Run these actions”.
